falsification_conditions.condition: The price closes above the 2019 pattern's peak by 10% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear breakout above historical resistance would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal by showing momentum contrary to the blowoff pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume falls below 50% of the 2019 pattern's peak volume for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained low volume would contradict the blowoff score's implication of high volatility and market participation

falsification_conditions.condition: The VIX index drops below 20 (its 2019 jun level) for 5 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant decline in volatility would directly contradict the blowoff scenario's expectation of heightened market stress

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
